# Recorded Deviceinfo documents

`Deviceinfo.xml` documents recorded from real receivers, taken from the test
data of [ol-iver/denonavr](https://github.com/ol-iver/denonavr)
(`tests/xml/`, commit a8209c4), MIT licence, copyright Oliver Götz; see
`LICENSE` in this folder.

The documents were already anonymised there (every MAC address is the
placeholder `0123456789AB`) and are used unchanged. Files named `*-8080.xml`
come from receivers that serve the document on port 8080 (2016 and later);
the others from port 80.

The `*-formMainZone_MainZoneXml.xml` files are the main zone pages of the
2010–2012 receivers (AVR-1912, AVR-2312CI, AVR-3311CI, AVR-3312, AVR-4810)
and the M-CR603 system, from the same test data, unchanged.
